conversations.title: Choosing a Data Plan
conversations.description: Choose the best mobile offer for your needs.

messages.text: Buongiorno! Come posso aiutarla oggi?
messages.english: Good morning! How can I help you today?

choices.text: Vorrei comprare una nuova scheda SIM.
choices.english: I would like to buy a new SIM card.

choices.text: Il mio telefono è rotto e non si accende.
choices.english: My phone is broken and won't turn on.
choices.feedback: This is for phone repair, not buying a SIM.

choices.text: Cerco un caricabatterie per il tablet.
choices.english: I am looking for a tablet charger.
choices.feedback: You need a SIM card, not a charger.

messages.text: Certamente. Abbiamo diverse offerte. Cerca giga o minuti?
messages.english: Certainly. We have several offers. Are you looking for gigs or minutes?

choices.text: Cerco un piano con molti giga per internet.
choices.english: I am looking for a plan with many gigs for internet.

choices.text: Voglio solo fare una chiamata internazionale.
choices.english: I just want to make an international call.
choices.feedback: You want a full plan, not just one call.

choices.text: Non mi servono dati, solo una mappa.
choices.english: I don't need data, just a map.
choices.feedback: The host is asking about the plan type.

messages.text: Abbiamo il piano 'Giga Illimitati' a venti euro al mese.
messages.english: We have the 'Unlimited Gigs' plan for twenty euros a month.

choices.text: Venti euro è un po' caro. Avete qualcosa di più economico?
choices.english: Twenty euros is a bit expensive. Do you have something cheaper?

choices.text: Il segnale è molto debole in questa zona.
choices.english: The signal is very weak in this area.
choices.feedback: You are discussing the price, not the coverage yet.

choices.text: Mi piace il colore della scheda SIM.
choices.english: I like the color of the SIM card.
choices.feedback: Focus on the offer details.

messages.text: Sì, c'è l'offerta 'Smart' con 50 giga a dieci euro.
messages.english: Yes, there is the 'Smart' offer with 50 gigs for ten euros.

choices.text: Dieci euro va bene. Sono inclusi anche i minuti?
choices.english: Ten euros is fine. Are minutes included too?

choices.text: Preferisco pagare con una carta di credito.
choices.english: I prefer to pay with a credit card.
choices.feedback: Ask about the plan features first.

choices.text: Dov'è il bagno più vicino, per favore?
choices.english: Where is the nearest bathroom, please?
choices.feedback: Stay focused on the SIM card purchase.

messages.text: Sì, ha minuti illimitati verso tutti i numeri italiani.
messages.english: Yes, it has unlimited minutes to all Italian numbers.

choices.text: Ottimo. Posso usare il telefono anche all'estero?
choices.english: Great. Can I use the phone abroad too?

choices.text: Non voglio parlare con nessuno oggi.
choices.english: I don't want to talk to anyone today.
choices.feedback: A bit negative! You are asking about international use.

choices.text: Il prefisso internazionale è corretto?
choices.english: Is the international prefix correct?
choices.feedback: You haven't even got the number yet.

messages.text: Sì, ha 5 giga inclusi per il roaming in Europa.
messages.english: Yes, it has 5 gigs included for roaming in Europe.

choices.text: Perfetto. È un abbonamento o una ricaricabile?
choices.english: Perfect. Is it a subscription or a rechargeable?

choices.text: Mio nonno vive in America ora.
choices.english: My grandfather lives in America now.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant personal information.

choices.text: Non mi piace viaggiare in treno.
choices.english: I don't like traveling by train.
choices.feedback: Stay on topic: mobile data.

messages.text: È una ricaricabile. Può ricaricare quando vuole.
messages.english: It's a rechargeable. You can top up whenever you want.

choices.text: Molto bene. Voglio questa offerta.
choices.english: Very well. I want this offer.

choices.text: Il contratto è troppo lungo da leggere.
choices.english: The contract is too long to read.
choices.feedback: It's a rechargeable, usually there's less paperwork.

choices.text: Preferisco un telefono fisso a casa.
choices.english: I prefer a landline at home.
choices.feedback: You are in a mobile shop!

messages.text: Benissimo. La scheda costa cinque euro una volta sola.
messages.english: Great. The card costs five euros only once.

choices.text: Va bene, quindi in totale sono quindici euro?
choices.english: Fine, so is it fifteen euros in total?

choices.text: Posso avere uno sconto per studenti?
choices.english: Can I have a student discount?
choices.feedback: Good question, but confirm the total first.

choices.text: La ricarica è gratuita oggi?
choices.english: Is the top-up free today?
choices.feedback: Nothing is free in the mobile business!

messages.text: Esatto. Dieci per il piano e cinque per la SIM.
messages.english: Exactly. Ten for the plan and five for the SIM.

choices.text: Ecco a lei i soldi. Grazie.
choices.english: Here is the money for you. Thanks.

choices.text: Non trovo il mio portafoglio.
choices.english: I can't find my wallet.
choices.feedback: Try to be prepared to pay!

choices.text: Voglio pagare con dei francobolli.
choices.english: I want to pay with stamps.
choices.feedback: They only accept cash or cards.

messages.text: Grazie. Ora passiamo ai documenti.
messages.english: Thank you. Now let's move on to the documents.

choices.text: Certamente, sono pronto.
choices.english: Certainly, I am ready.

choices.text: Non ho documenti con me.
choices.english: I don't have documents with me.
choices.feedback: You need them to buy a SIM in Italy!

choices.text: Dove posso mangiare una pizza?
choices.english: Where can I eat a pizza?
choices.feedback: Forbidden topic! Focus on the SIM.

conversations.title: Required Documents
conversations.description: Provide the necessary identification for the SIM activation.

messages.text: Per attivare la SIM mi serve un documento d'identità.
messages.english: To activate the SIM I need an identity document.

choices.text: Va bene il passaporto o serve la carta d'identità?
choices.english: Is the passport okay or do I need an ID card?

choices.text: Ho solo la tessera della biblioteca.
choices.english: I only have a library card.
choices.feedback: That's not a valid government ID.

choices.text: Ecco la mia patente di guida scaduta.
choices.english: Here is my expired driver's license.
choices.feedback: The document must be valid.

messages.text: Il passaporto va benissimo se è in corso di validità.
messages.english: The passport is fine if it is valid.

choices.text: Ecco il mio passaporto originale.
choices.english: Here is my original passport.

choices.text: Posso darle una foto sul cellulare?
choices.english: Can I give you a photo on my phone?
choices.feedback: They usually need the physical document.

choices.text: Il mio passaporto è a casa in albergo.
choices.english: My passport is at home in the hotel.
choices.feedback: You need it with you now.

messages.text: Grazie. Devo fare una fotocopia del documento.
messages.english: Thank you. I need to make a photocopy of the document.

choices.text: Posso farla io o la fa lei qui in negozio?
choices.english: Can I do it or do you do it here in the shop?

choices.text: Non voglio che tocchi il mio passaporto.
choices.english: I don't want you to touch my passport.
choices.feedback: The clerk needs to handle it for the copy.

choices.text: Ho una stampante nel mio zaino.
choices.english: I have a printer in my backpack.
choices.feedback: Highly unlikely and unnecessary.

messages.text: La faccio io subito, non si preoccupi.
messages.english: I'll do it right away, don't worry.

choices.text: Grazie mille. Serve altro?
choices.english: Thanks a lot. Do you need anything else?

choices.text: Quanto costa fare una fotocopia?
choices.english: How much does it cost to make a photocopy?
choices.feedback: Usually it's free for customers.

choices.text: Voglio una copia a colori, per favore.
choices.english: I want a color copy, please.
choices.feedback: Black and white is enough for them.

messages.text: Mi serve anche il suo codice fiscale, se lo ha.
messages.english: I also need your tax code, if you have it.

choices.text: Purtroppo non ho il codice fiscale italiano.
choices.english: Unfortunately I don't have an Italian tax code.

choices.text: Ecco il mio codice fiscale, è 12345.
choices.english: Here is my tax code, it is 12345.
choices.feedback: Italian tax codes are alphanumeric and longer.

choices.text: Non so cos'è un codice fiscale.
choices.english: I don't know what a tax code is.
choices.feedback: As a tourist, it's okay not to have one.

messages.text: Nessun problema, possiamo usare il suo luogo di nascita.
messages.english: No problem, we can use your place of birth.

choices.text: Va bene. Sono nato a Londra.
choices.english: Fine. I was born in London.

choices.text: Sono nato in un ospedale molto grande.
choices.english: I was born in a very large hospital.
choices.feedback: Be more specific with the city name.

choices.text: Non ricordo dove sono nato.
choices.english: I don't remember where I was born.
choices.feedback: Check your passport!

messages.text: Perfetto. Ora devo inserire i dati nel sistema.
messages.english: Perfect. Now I have to enter the data into the system.

choices.text: Ci vuole molto tempo per questa operazione?
choices.english: Does it take a long time for this operation?

choices.text: Il sistema è connesso a internet?
choices.english: Is the system connected to the internet?
choices.feedback: Of course it is, you're in a tech shop.

choices.text: Voglio vedere lo schermo del computer.
choices.english: I want to see the computer screen.
choices.feedback: That's private for the shop staff.

messages.text: No, solo pochi minuti. Deve firmare questo modulo.
messages.english: No, just a few minutes. You have to sign this form.

choices.text: Dove devo firmare esattamente?
choices.english: Where do I have to sign exactly?

choices.text: Non mi piace la mia firma oggi.
choices.english: I don't like my signature today.
choices.feedback: Just sign it as usual.

choices.text: Posso firmare con una matita?
choices.english: Can I sign with a pencil?
choices.feedback: Official documents require a pen.

messages.text: Qui in fondo, vicino alla croce.
messages.english: Here at the bottom, near the cross.

choices.text: Ecco fatto. Ho firmato.
choices.english: Done. I have signed.

choices.text: Devo scrivere anche la data?
choices.english: Do I have to write the date too?
choices.feedback: Only if requested by the clerk.

choices.text: La penna non scrive bene.
choices.english: The pen doesn't write well.
choices.feedback: Try again or ask for another pen.

messages.text: Ottimo. Abbiamo finito con i documenti.
messages.english: Great. We are done with the documents.

choices.text: Grazie. Quando sarà attiva la scheda?
choices.english: Thanks. When will the card be active?

choices.text: Posso riavere il mio passaporto?
choices.english: Can I have my passport back?
choices.feedback: Good point, but ask about activation too.

choices.text: Voglio comprare anche un giornale.
choices.english: I want to buy a newspaper too.
choices.feedback: This is a mobile shop, not a newsstand.

conversations.title: SIM Card Activation
conversations.description: Insert and configure your new SIM card.

messages.text: Ecco la sua nuova scheda SIM. Che formato le serve?
messages.english: Here is your new SIM card. What format do you need?

choices.text: Mi serve il formato nano per il mio smartphone.
choices.english: I need the nano format for my smartphone.

choices.text: Voglio una scheda molto grande.
choices.english: I want a very large card.
choices.feedback: Modern phones use small cards.

choices.text: Non so cos'è uno smartphone.
choices.english: I don't know what a smartphone is.
choices.feedback: You probably have one if you're buying a SIM.

messages.text: Nessun problema, la scheda è pre-tagliata in tutti i formati.
messages.english: No problem, the card is pre-cut in all formats.

choices.text: Devo inserirla io o può aiutarmi lei?
choices.english: Do I have to insert it or can you help me?

choices.text: Voglio tagliare la scheda con le forbici.
choices.english: I want to cut the card with scissors.
choices.feedback: Don't! It's already pre-cut.

choices.text: La scheda è troppo sottile.
choices.english: The card is too thin.
choices.feedback: That's normal for SIM cards.

messages.text: Posso farlo io. Mi dia pure il suo telefono.
messages.english: I can do it. Give me your phone.

choices.text: Ecco il mio cellulare. Grazie.
choices.english: Here is my cell phone. Thanks.

choices.text: Non voglio dare il mio telefono a nessuno.
choices.english: I don't want to give my phone to anyone.
choices.feedback: The clerk is just helping with the SIM.

choices.text: Il mio telefono è a ricaricare a casa.
choices.english: My phone is charging at home.
choices.feedback: You need it here to test the SIM.

messages.text: Grazie. Tolgo la vecchia SIM e metto la nuova.
messages.english: Thank you. I'm taking out the old SIM and putting in the new one.

choices.text: Devo inserire un codice PIN ora?
choices.english: Do I have to enter a PIN code now?

choices.text: Voglio tenere la vecchia scheda.
choices.english: I want to keep the old card.
choices.feedback: You can keep it, but it won't work.

choices.text: Il mio telefono è diventato nero.
choices.english: My phone has turned black.
choices.feedback: It's just the screen turning off.

messages.text: Sì, il PIN predefinito è 0000. Può cambiarlo dopo.
messages.english: Yes, the default PIN is 0000. You can change it later.

choices.text: Ho inserito il PIN. Vedo che non c'è ancora segnale.
choices.english: I entered the PIN. I see there is no signal yet.

choices.text: Voglio un PIN più difficile, tipo 1234.
choices.english: I want a harder PIN, like 1234.
choices.feedback: That's actually a very common PIN.

choices.text: Il telefono dice che il PIN è sbagliato.
choices.english: The phone says the PIN is wrong.
choices.feedback: Try 0000 again carefully.

messages.text: È normale. L'attivazione richiede circa due ore.
messages.english: It's normal. Activation takes about two hours.

choices.text: Quindi non posso chiamare subito?
choices.english: So I can't call right away?

choices.text: Due ore sono troppe, voglio ora!
choices.english: Two hours are too many, I want it now!
choices.feedback: Patience is needed for network activation.

choices.text: Posso aspettare qui in negozio?
choices.english: Can I wait here in the shop?
choices.feedback: You can, but it's better to go for a walk.

messages.text: Per ora no. Riceverà un messaggio di conferma.
messages.english: For now, no. You will receive a confirmation message.

choices.text: Come faccio a sapere se la scheda è attiva?
choices.english: How do I know if the card is active?

choices.text: Non mi piacciono i messaggi, preferisco le lettere.
choices.english: I don't like messages, I prefer letters.
choices.feedback: Network operators always use SMS.

choices.text: Il messaggio sarà in italiano o in inglese?
choices.english: Will the message be in Italian or English?
choices.feedback: Likely in Italian.

messages.text: Quando vede le tacche del segnale e il nome dell'operatore.
messages.english: When you see the signal bars and the operator's name.

choices.text: Va bene, aspetterò il messaggio allora.
choices.english: Fine, I will wait for the message then.

choices.text: Vedo solo una tacca, è poco.
choices.english: I see only one bar, it's not much.
choices.feedback: Wait for full activation.

choices.text: Il nome dell'operatore è troppo lungo.
choices.english: The operator's name is too long.
choices.feedback: That doesn't matter for the service.

messages.text: Le consiglio di riavviare il telefono tra un'ora.
messages.english: I advise you to restart the phone in an hour.

choices.text: Grazie del consiglio, lo farò sicuramente.
choices.english: Thanks for the advice, I will definitely do it.

choices.text: Non so come si spegne il telefono.
choices.english: I don't know how to turn off the phone.
choices.feedback: Usually it's a side button.

choices.text: Voglio riavviarlo ogni cinque minuti.
choices.english: I want to restart it every five minutes.
choices.feedback: Once is enough.

messages.text: Di nulla! Ha altre domande sulla configurazione?
messages.english: You're welcome! Do you have any other questions about the configuration?

choices.text: No, grazie. È stato tutto molto chiaro.
choices.english: No, thanks. Everything was very clear.

choices.text: Sì, come si cucina la pasta?
choices.english: Yes, how do you cook pasta?
choices.feedback: Forbidden topic! Stick to tech.

choices.text: Voglio configurare un computer quantistico.
choices.english: I want to configure a quantum computer.
choices.feedback: A bit too advanced for this shop!

conversations.title: Topping Up Credit
conversations.description: Add credit to your prepaid mobile line.

messages.text: Buongiorno! Vuole ricaricare il suo credito residuo?
messages.english: Good morning! Do you want to top up your remaining credit?

choices.text: Sì, vorrei fare una ricarica da dieci euro.
choices.english: Yes, I would like to make a ten-euro top-up.

choices.text: No, voglio solo un gelato.
choices.english: No, I just want a gelato.
choices.feedback: Wrong shop! This is a mobile store.

choices.text: Voglio scaricare tutti i giga.
choices.english: I want to download all the gigs.
choices.feedback: You need credit first to use gigs.

messages.text: Certamente. Mi dica il suo numero di telefono.
messages.english: Certainly. Tell me your phone number.

choices.text: Il mio numero è 320 123 4567.
choices.english: My number is 320 123 4567.

choices.text: Il mio numero è segreto, non posso dirlo.
choices.english: My number is secret, I can't say it.
choices.feedback: The clerk needs it to process the top-up.

choices.text: Ecco il mio numero civico: 42.
choices.english: Here is my house number: 42.
choices.feedback: They need your phone number, not address.

messages.text: Può ripetere le ultime tre cifre, per favore?
messages.english: Can you repeat the last three digits, please?

choices.text: Sì, sono cinque, sei, sette.
choices.english: Yes, they are five, six, seven.

choices.text: No, non voglio ripetere nulla.
choices.english: No, I don't want to repeat anything.
choices.feedback: It's just to confirm the number is correct.

choices.text: Le cifre sono molte grandi.
choices.english: The digits are very large.
choices.feedback: Just say the numbers.

messages.text: Perfetto. Vuole pagare con carta o in contanti?
messages.english: Perfect. Do you want to pay by card or in cash?

choices.text: Preferisco pagare in contanti, ecco la banconota.
choices.english: I prefer to pay in cash, here is the banknote.

choices.text: Voglio pagare con una canzone.
choices.english: I want to pay with a song.
choices.feedback: That's not a valid payment method.

choices.text: Non ho soldi oggi, forse domani.
choices.english: I have no money today, maybe tomorrow.
choices.feedback: You need money to buy credit.

messages.text: Grazie. Ecco il suo scontrino con la conferma.
messages.english: Thank you. Here is your receipt with the confirmation.

choices.text: Devo fare altro per attivare la ricarica?
choices.english: Do I have to do anything else to activate the top-up?

choices.text: Voglio mangiare lo scontrino.
choices.english: I want to eat the receipt.
choices.feedback: Don't! You might need it if there's a problem.

choices.text: Dov'è il cestino della spazzatura?
choices.english: Where is the trash can?
choices.feedback: Keep the receipt for now.

messages.text: No, è automatica. Riceverà un SMS tra poco.
messages.english: No, it's automatic. You will receive an SMS shortly.

choices.text: Posso ricaricare anche tramite l'app dell'operatore?
choices.english: Can I also top up via the operator's app?

choices.text: Non mi piacciono i messaggi corti.
choices.english: I don't like short messages.
choices.feedback: It's just a notification.

choices.text: Il mio telefono non riceve SMS.
choices.english: My phone doesn't receive SMS.
choices.feedback: It should, if the SIM is working.

messages.text: Certamente, è molto comodo e veloce.
messages.english: Certainly, it is very convenient and fast.

choices.text: Come si chiama l'app che devo scaricare?
choices.english: What is the name of the app I need to download?

choices.text: Non ho spazio sul telefono per le app.
choices.english: I have no space on the phone for apps.
choices.feedback: You can delete some old photos.

choices.text: L'app costa molti soldi?
choices.english: Does the app cost a lot of money?
choices.feedback: The operator app is usually free.

messages.text: Si chiama 'Il Mio Operatore'. La trova nello store.
messages.english: It's called 'My Operator'. You can find it in the store.

choices.text: Grazie. Posso controllare il credito anche chiamando un numero?
choices.english: Thanks. Can I also check the credit by calling a number?

choices.text: Voglio chiamare il mio operatore a casa.
choices.english: I want to call my operator at home.
choices.feedback: The app is easier for that.

choices.text: Ho capito. È possibile ricaricare la scheda anche dal sito web?
choices.english: I understand. Is it possible to top up the card also from the website?
choices.feedback: Yes, but the question was about the app.

messages.text: Sì, può chiamare il 40916 per il credito residuo.
messages.english: Yes, you can call 40916 for the remaining credit.

choices.text: Benissimo. Grazie mille per l'aiuto.
choices.english: Very well. Thanks a lot for the help.

choices.text: Il numero è troppo lungo da ricordare.
choices.english: The number is too long to remember.
choices.feedback: You can save it in your contacts.

choices.text: Voglio parlare con un robot.
choices.english: I want to talk to a robot.
choices.feedback: The automated number is essentially a robot.

messages.text: Prego! Buona giornata e buona navigazione!
messages.english: You're welcome! Have a good day and happy surfing!

choices.text: Grazie, buona giornata anche a lei!
choices.english: Thanks, have a good day too!

choices.text: Non so nuotare, non voglio navigare.
choices.english: I can't swim, I don't want to surf.
choices.feedback: In this context, it means surfing the internet.

choices.text: A che ora chiude il negozio?
choices.english: What time does the shop close?
choices.feedback: Just say goodbye and enjoy your day.
